data.title: Farm Hub: safe zones, one-tap check-ins and tasks for your child.
data.lead: Know your child arrived at school safely without calling to check in. Farm Hub (FamHub in app stores) connects parents and kids with a safe-zone map, a one-tap check-in button and a daily task board.
data.sub: Minimalist design with two separate modes for Parents and Children. Live location only turns on when the child chooses, and shuts off automatically after 60 minutes.

data.title: Solving parents' real worries with production-grade engineering.
data.intro: We don't turn your child's phone into 24/7 surveillance that creates pressure. Farm Hub is designed with family consent and the strictest Apple & Google review standards.

items.title: Automatic safe-zone alerts
items.body: Set up to 3 important locations (Home, School, Park). OS-level Geofencing notifies parents when the child arrives or leaves — even with the screen off.

items.title: 60-minute location that respects the child
items.body: Live location only broadcasts when the child taps on, then stops and clears coordinates after 60 minutes. Parents can send a gentle reminder with one tap.

items.title: Family pairing with a 6-character code
items.body: The child needs no email or complex password. Just enter the 6-character code (e.g. KDS-482) from the parent's phone to pair devices in 30 seconds.

items.title: Optimized Mapbox costs
items.body: High-resolution 512px vector/raster tiles (@2x) cut map tile requests by 75% versus traditional 256px tiles while staying sharp.

items.title: Multilingual & multi-device
items.body: 7 languages built in (Vietnamese, English, Japanese, Chinese, Indonesian, Portuguese) and works great on iPhone, iPad Pro 13 and Android phones and tablets.

items.title: Child privacy compliance
items.body: No ad SDKs, no data selling, transparent location-permission screen for the child, and instant account deletion in Settings.

data.title: Four steps to connect your family in under 2 minutes.
data.intro: Install the same app on the parent's phone and the child's phone, pick the right role on first launch and you're ready.

steps.title: Pick roles & pair with a code
steps.body: Parents create an account and get a 6-character code; the child chooses Child mode and enters the code to pair the two phones.

steps.title: Set 3 safe zones on the map
steps.body: Mark Home, School and Park on the map to receive automatic alerts every day.

steps.title: Child taps check-in while moving
steps.body: The child taps Going to school, Arrived or turns on 60-minute live location when they need a pickup.

steps.title: Tasks & message feedback
steps.body: Parents assign daily tasks; the child marks them complete and sends a pickup-time message.
